componentDescription:
Wrapper that renders a spacer + the MessageMeta absolutely positioned at the
bottom-right of the parent bubble. Uses the Telegram-style "spacer + absolute
positioning" trick so the meta appears inline with short text and at the
bottom-right for long text.

Must be rendered inside a bubble with `position: relative`.

slotProps.description: The props used for each component slot.

slotDescriptions.edited: The component that renders the edited.
slotDescriptions.meta: The component that renders the meta.
slotDescriptions.status: The component that renders the status.
slotDescriptions.streamingProgress: The root element of the streaming progress indicator. Rendered by Base UI Progress.Root when message.status === 'streaming'. Provides role="progressbar" and aria-valuetext for screen readers.
slotDescriptions.streamingProgressIndicator: The animated indicator bar inside the streaming progress track.
slotDescriptions.streamingProgressTrack: The track element wrapping the streaming progress indicator.
slotDescriptions.timestamp: The component that renders the timestamp.
